source: Real extension UI with generated fixtures, mock figure cards, synthetic API responses and an example model catalog. Expanded gallery and analysis captures use 0.8.16; unchanged document/model views use labeled 0.8.15 captures and webpage/selection views use labeled 0.8.7 captures. Capture versions, crops and hashes are recorded below; provider speed and accuracy are not measured.
